source_findings.finding: HEAD-versus-working-tree proof/chain mutation detection only; no parent-transition history walk.
Historical guard precedes baseline and physical epoch checks; passing or checkpointing chain history does not bypass later validation.
Broker owns canonical root, policy repository ID, actual invocation/issuer and exact installed B5 calculation; ordinary host scope lacks root/B5.

minimal_bridge.transport: Separate scope/issuer/invocation/root-bound WeakMap observation capsule; fixed eligible existing actions; no mutating invocation/role inference/caller provider.
observations: actual local issuer-authenticated approval and phase01/02 intent/completion linkage
exact unchanged current B5 and HEAD/merge identity
custody manifest approved source SHA and original object SHA/GitOID/body
selected parent actual merge-parent original chain
exact authenticated selected-chain plus selection-event base
valid append-only suffix after selected base
minimal_bridge.exception: Only canonical active-chain HEAD-prefix replacement finding during exact approved unresolved merge. Preserve original finding when native authentication is absent/invalid/drifting; never bypass proof epoch history or baseline/anchor/declaration checks.
minimal_bridge.read_only: No admission-lock creation, private-state writes, general capability, signer or mutator. Double snapshot/revalidate and refuse concurrent drift.
minimal_bridge.clean_head: When current chain equals HEAD no checkpoint is necessary for this historical guard; all other checks retain their own outcomes.

counterexamples: caller JSON or copied receipt cannot authorize
selection receipt/event alone without native authentication refuses
tampered custody or selected historical object refuses
noncanonical chain and epoch rewrites never exempt
clean committed checkout never requires local private issuer
qualification: Independent source/design review only; no implementation, new protocol, product edits, CI success or public runtime claim.
